items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Arthur Zikins(?) was playing the clavinet.

ctx.x: A guy by the name of Lenny Hartley was playing the RMI, and Arthur Zikins(?) was playing the clavinet. And the drummer was Candy Finch. So musically, we knew where we were going. We had accepted it, and we were seriously...with the arrangements, and had us some good charts. And we knew we were kind of turning the people around because we were stretching with the music. We were playing fusion...
But the people weren't stretching with you...
